description:
Permanently release a phone number after explicit user authorization.

        A mismatched ``confirm_e164`` returns an error without releasing anything.
        Calls and texts to a released number stop. Recovery is not guaranteed.
        Current and previous monthly fees remain due, without a refund.
        Pending orders cannot be released and return 409.
        A failed order was not purchased; this operation only dismisses it from the list.
        A connected number (``source`` ``connected``) is only removed from Hail:
        it stays with the customer's phone system and provider.
        Returns ``released`` or ``dismissed``, plus ``number_id`` and ``e164``, or an error.

confirm_e164.description: The number's ``e164`` value, such as ``+14155551234``, as a safety check.
confirm_e164.title: Confirm E164

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_id.description: Workspace phone number ID, from ``list_numbers`` or ``acquire_number``.
number_id.title: Number Id

name: release_number
title: Release a number
